newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 slips on earnings concerns, Dow drop.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 slips on earnings concerns, Dow drop.

text.p: A set of disappointing results from Barclays Plc and a pause on Wall Street kept a lid on UK shares on Tuesday, dealers and strategists said.

The leading FTSE 100 index of shares sank 5.5 points to 4,332.3, near the day's low of 4,331.2. Decliners narrowly beat advancers 51 to 45. The Dow, which opened a bit firmer, was down 8.5 points when London markets closed.

The mood in the market turned cautious early in the session as Barclays posted pre-tax profits of 2.36 billion. The results, which were on the low end of market expectations, sparked analyst downgrades, driving the shares down 70p to 1129-1/2.
